execution_policy.reason: WP07-D preparation remains blocked until WP04 M3 completion.

scope.active_set: LINEAR_ACTIVE_SET_INITIAL_SEARCH: linear_static, small displacement, frictionless node-to-triangle contact, initial/fixed face and normal, serial direct sparse
scope.penalty: NONLINEAR_PENALTY_INITIAL_SEARCH: geometric_nonlinear_static, fixed-normal initial-search frictionless node-to-triangle penalty, existing common Full Newton route
scope.element_family: TET4 only for both prospective benchmarks
scope.master_surface: rigid/fixed faceted master triangle with ordered normal +Z
excluded: stress singularity at the contact edge as a primary observable

body_symmetry: UX=0 on body nodes with x=0
UY=0 on body nodes with y=0
boundary_conditions.body_vertical_support: contact only; no body UZ clamp

contact_topology.slave_nodes: all body nodes on z=0.01 bottom face

loading.physical_definition: uniform downward traction on the full top rectangle z=0.21
loading.nodal_assembly: consistent equivalent nodal forces from constant-traction T3 surface integration; each top triangular face contributes traction*area/3 to each vertex
loading.top_face_triangulation: deterministic boundary T3 faces induced by the frozen TET4 subdivision
loading.mesh_independence: same physical traction, same total resultant and same origin moment at M1/M2/M3
loading.public_solver_input: nodal dead loads only; no production distributed-load feature is added

mesh_recipe.domain_discretization: structured cells over the same rectangular body at every level
mesh_recipe.orientation_policy: compute signed reference volume; reject zero/nonfinite; if negative, swap the final two local nodes deterministically
mesh_recipe.quality_policy: finite coordinates, positive repaired signed volume and declared quality report before solve

ACTIVE_SET.contact_behavior: unilateral exact normal constraint; compression activates bottom slave nodes
ACTIVE_SET.primary_claim: bounded structural active-set contact response for the declared TET4 block and load

PENALTY.line_search: existing canonical geometric-static policy; no experimental override
PENALTY.checkpoint: accepted state and WP07-B compatible metadata only; no independent penalty contact history
PENALTY.primary_claim: bounded structural penalty response within the declared load, material and kinematic envelope
PENALTY.energy_claim: contact energy only where fixed-normal penalty interpretation and finite observables are valid

ACTIVE_SET: selected displacement: mean UZ of the top loaded face
reaction resultant: vector at fixed/master supports
reaction moment: vector about global origin
active contact count and area-weighted active contact region
minimum signed gap and normalized gap
PENALTY: selected displacement: mean UZ of the top loaded face
reaction resultant: vector at fixed/master supports
reaction moment: vector about global origin
fixed-normal penalty contact energy where valid
accepted load-factor history and terminal status
observables.stress_policy: optional averaged Cauchy sigma_zz in 0.40<=X/L<=0.60, 0.20<=Y/W<=0.80, 0.25<=Z/H<=0.75 using reference-volume weights; never contact-edge point stress

load_path_and_restart.penalty_adaptive_behavior: disabled for the frozen first campaign; any future approved policy must be supplied as a separate policy artifact
load_path_and_restart.penalty_restart: restore accepted state, validate model/contact/state digests per WP07-B, re-evaluate stateless penalty contact
load_path_and_restart.active_set_restart: mid-solve restart UNSUPPORTED; fresh solve only

external_reference_plan.primary: independent reduced reference implementation on the same declared TET4 mesh, nodal loads, fixed-normal node-to-triangle constraints and penalty value; separate assembly path required
external_reference_plan.secondary: Code_Aster or another compatible solver only after explicit mapping of node-to-surface enforcement, normal orientation, penalty/constraint parameters, units and observables
comparison_fields: contact resultant/penetration for penalty where comparable
path/status only when load control is equivalent
external_reference_plan.stress_policy: compare only averaged, formulation-compatible regions; contact-edge stress is not a primary comparison
external_reference_plan.non_equivalent_status: EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_NOT_EQUIVALENT; do not use as qualification evidence

negative_cases.expected: contract preflight detects orientation mismatch and fails closed with typed validation result; no PASS claim
PASS_OPEN_NO_CONTACT diagnostic; no contact qualification PASS inferred from an open case
NumericalConvergenceError with CONTACT_PENETRATION_EXCESSIVE, or explicit route-native failure
UNSUPPORTED_EXPLICIT with route-native InputValidationError/MeshValidationError; no fallback
evidence validation failure; no PASS and no NaN/Inf serialization
InputValidationError from WP07-B metadata validation; fail closed

harness.purpose: no-solve preflight and future deterministic case plan
harness.execution_guard: structural and external execution disabled by preflight until WP04 M3 completion

resource_estimates.qualification: not resource-qualified; estimates exclude measured solver fill-in, Python overhead, telemetry and process contention
resource_estimates.WP04_priority: M3 waits until Agent A WP04-C2R6 campaign completes
